status: frozen before target-file download and row-level outcome inspection
history: Only the CaltechDATA record metadata were inspected before freezing: 571 Li-containing compounds, reported room-temperature ionic conductivity, ICSD identifiers, source DOI, lowest measurement temperature, file name, checksum, and CC0 license. No target CSV row or conductivity value was inspected.
scientific_question: After exact identity and article overlap removal, can same-property or transport-adjacent experimental source domains improve broad OOD recovery beyond a validated composition-novelty policy while automatically suppressing unrelated sources?

target.name: Experimental Li-Ion Conductivity and Crystal Structure Database
target.outcome: reported room-temperature Li ionic conductivity in S/cm
target.schema_rule: case-fold, trim punctuation and units, then require exactly one allowed match for formula, outcome, DOI and ICSD; lowest-temperature is required for the prespecified sensitivity but not the primary analysis
target.schema_failure_rule: stop without inspecting target outcomes if formula, outcome, DOI or ICSD cannot be resolved uniquely

target_quality_gates.duplicate_components: union rows connected by canonical composition, normalized DOI, or nonempty ICSD code before any split
target_quality_gates.entity_aggregation: median log10 conductivity per canonical composition after connected-component assignment
target_quality_gates.near_room_temperature_sensitivity: retain records with lowest measured temperature <= 350 K; if temperature units are not explicit and recoverable, mark sensitivity unavailable rather than infer

fixed_representation.features: 118 atomic-number-ordered element fractions plus the eight deterministic composition descriptors in analysis.common.composition_features
fixed_representation.structure_features_forbidden_in_primary: ICSD is used only for grouping; structure availability must not change inclusion or features
fixed_representation.novelty: Euclidean distance in standardized composition-feature space to the currently labelled target set

source_leakage_rules.formula: exclude every source row whose canonical composition occurs anywhere in the eligible target database
source_leakage_rules.article: exclude every source row whose normalized DOI occurs anywhere in the eligible target database
source_leakage_rules.source_model: ExtraTreesRegressor with 240 trees, min_samples_leaf=2, max_features=0.7 and fixed seed
source_leakage_rules.source_quality: three-fold group-aware OOF R2 and rank correlation are reported; a source prediction is unavailable if fewer than 100 leakage-safe entities remain

target_split.group: connected component of canonical composition, normalized DOI and nonempty ICSD code
target_split.assignment: outcome-blind SHA-256 ordering of group identifiers followed by row-balanced 70% development and 30% external candidate partitions
target_split.hard_ood_scope: the 40% of candidate entities farthest from the full development partition by nearest-neighbor composition distance
target_split.split_failure_rule: stop if any minimum is missed; do not alter proportions after inspecting outcomes

campaign.initial_sampling: group-aware deterministic samples from the development partition
campaign.target_model: ExtraTreesRegressor with 80 trees, min_samples_leaf=2, max_features=0.7, n_jobs=1
campaign.primary_endpoint: area under the cumulative true-top-5-percent hit curve through acquisition 20
campaign.primary_reason: broad recovery is less vulnerable than first hit to one lucky candidate and better matches OOD exploration
campaign.guardrail_endpoint: acquisitions to first true top-5-percent hit
secondary_endpoints: best observed target value and regret at acquisitions 10, 20 and 40
area under the cumulative-hit curve through acquisition 40

safe_policy.name: cross-validated residual-rank gating with novelty fallback
safe_policy.target_backbone: novelty rank plus a target-mean rank whose weight is estimated from group-aware OOF improvement over the training-mean predictor
safe_policy.source_gate: for each source, compare composition-only and composition-plus-one-source ExtraTrees models in five group-aware outer folds of the currently labelled target set
safe_policy.source_admission: median relative RMSE gain >= 0.02, at least three of five folds positive, and mean signed gain positive
safe_policy.source_correction: rank(prediction from augmented model) minus rank(prediction from composition-only model)
safe_policy.acquisition_score: novelty rank + target_weight * target-mean rank + sum of admitted source_weight * source_correction rank; at most two sources with the largest admitted gains
safe_policy.fallback: if target mean and all sources fail their gates, the score is exactly composition novelty
safe_policy.negative_transfer_guard: unrelated or shuffled sources must be admitted in fewer than 20% of acquisition steps and have mean weight < 0.10

inference.multiplicity: Holm correction across all seven named primary AUC20 contrasts within each candidate scope
inference.dataset_scope: campaign-seed uncertainty is conditional on this external database; no interval is interpreted as population uncertainty over databases

decision_gates.incremental_statistical: Holm p <= 0.05 and paired 95% interval lower bound > 0 for AUC20
decision_gates.incremental_practical: at least 20% mean AUC20 improvement relative to safe_target_novelty
decision_gates.consistency: at least 60% of paired campaigns improve
decision_gates.first_hit_noninferiority: source-aware mean first-hit count no more than two acquisitions worse than safe_target_novelty and paired 95% lower bound for saved acquisitions > -2
decision_gates.negative_transfer: both unrelated sources and the shuffled source satisfy the negative-transfer guard
decision_gates.scope_replication: direction agrees in the external candidate and hard-OOD scopes
decision_gates.claim_status: passing all gates supports one externally validated source-to-policy edge; it does not establish field-wide rescue or prospective laboratory discovery

new_science_guard.future_requirement: before target outcomes are revealed, write a source-derived composition-family or mechanism hypothesis and a matched-control test; retrospective top-hit recovery alone is not new science
